### The Parable of the Tenants
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/parable-tenants
Passage: Matthew 21:42
Points:
- Jesus rebuked religious leaders for failing to produce fruit and lead people to God.
- God's judgment fell on corrupt leadership, transferring stewardship to the new covenant community of Jews and Gentiles.
- The killing of the owner's son exposed humanity's deep rebellion against God's enduring patience.
- Though rejected by earthly builders, Jesus was exalted as the sovereign cornerstone over all kingdoms.
- True faith inevitably manifests in a life of discipleship and fruitful obedience to God.
